name: HiveMind
notes: New bottom board: Screened with oil pan. The hive's page gets an 🛢️ Oil pan section: log when the oil went in or was changed, and each check (beetles caught, oil OK or needs changing). A reminder to check it comes up every 14 days (change the days per hive).
In an inspection of an oil-pan hive: tap Oil pan checked or Oil changed, and the beetles in it. Or say "checked the oil pan, about twenty beetles" or "changed the oil".
Honey by apiary: the Harvest tab shows each apiary's honey for a year or every year. Tap an apiary to see its hives, then a hive to open it. A hive's honey tab shows its total and each year.
Treatments keep how much went in: grams, mL, strips and more, for the whole hive or per brood box (HiveMind works out the hive's total). A dribble also keeps the seams of bees.
Say or write "vaporized 2 grams of oxalic" or "dribbled 30 mL on 6 seams" and the method and amount fill in. Dribble and trickle are one choice now.
Peppermint is on the treatment list, for small hive beetles.
Treatment schedules take an amount too, and each hive's total is saved with it.
New things to record: bees added to a colony (package, nuc, frames, and from which hive), pesticide harm, frames of comb replaced, and at a dead-out whether the queen was found and the honey robbed.
The Bee Buddy Voice says more: amounts, seams, peppermint, and every "seen or done" item in the read-back (bearding, mouse guard on, swarmed and more). "Ounces" sounds right now.
